scope: Hosted Windows AMD64/ARM64 ordinary DNS resolution, scoped-static state restoration, DNSCrypt service-loss and automatic verification-failure rollback; supplemental ten-target compile and source/native regression.
limitations: Scope ownership and current-index binding have source contracts; the hosted static cases did not force a real interface-index change.
Ordinary resolver success and state equality do not prove encrypted wire transport, all upstream failure modes or reboot/power-loss recovery.
Signing/notarization, managed endpoints, operator/AT/four-language and eight-hour acceptance, sustained browser limits and held Mac/private-output work remain incomplete.
